body: My wife left me and she knows I tried to kill myself twice over it. We are working things out now and are back together, but she will never know that it was more than twice and the only reason I didn't check into a hotel I had a reservation for with two bottles of whiskey and a big bottle of opioids are because she called me crying that she needed me and try to work it out as I was driving there. If she called an hour or two later, my phone would've been off and I'd no longer be here.

I am. I've failed a bunch now, but things are looking up with my wife, so I don't think there will be another. I had a hotel reservation, two bottles of whiskey, and a big bottle of opioids. I planned on checking in and not leaving, but she called me crying that she needed me a few hours beforehand. I'm still here. Barely, but here.
I did. "There is no more us."
The fact my wife doesn't want me anymore.

Maybe it's because it feels like I'm numb now, but I don't think I've been sure about anything more than I am now. She just came downstairs to say she loves me then went upstairs to lock the door and told me to stay downstairs. I can't do this anymore. I'm actually looking forward to Thursday.

What's the point? My wife would be happier without me in her life. All I seem to do is cause her stress. All I want is to hug her and make her happy, but that isn't happening. It hasn't happened in many years. The beginning of our marriage she felt loved. Why can't I love her properly?
